verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships GNOME Boxes, which the official site says lets you pick an OS and have the app handle the rest. That matches the story's quick VM creation without manual configuration. The VirtualBox report concerns running Fedora as a guest elsewhere, not Fedora's own VM tooling, so it is not relevant here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Boxes (supported guest OSes, automatic install details, resource settings) and independent or hands-on corroboration of the VM experience on Fedora.

support.subject: As a developer, I can quickly create and run virtual machines without manual configuration

citations.quote: Boxes takes the guesswork out of using virtual machines. Just select the OS you want to install, and the app will do the rest.
